description: A set of natural numbers is computably enumerable if and only if an existential bounded-prefix arithmetic formula defines its membership in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.unary_enumerable_iff (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable fun v => A (v 0)
